decision: Parameters are predeclared screening candidates, not calibrated device specifications. If initialization convergence fails, do not deploy history-free LUT. COMSOL-only device extraction; Python orchestrates and analyses.
initialization_candidate_policy: Try 8, then 32, then 128 cumulative RESET pulses; standard READ checkpoint before each extension. Stop at first candidate meeting <=1% spread over all 17 levels. Probe branches never feed back into the initialization branch.
halfselect_scope: First test: ideal driven 2x2 passive crossbar, zero wire/port resistance. Actual cell biases are exactly V,V/2,V/2,0. Equivalent independent native device histories; do not claim finite-line coupled solution or a transistor model.

results.detail: Two native MPH copies have identical SHA-256; the 26 fingerprints of the original freeze package pass.
+0.8 V is SET, −0.8 V is RESET; read-conductance tolerance recheck difference 1.716e-09.
8 pulses: initialisation read spread 48.092%; 32 pulses: initialisation read spread 31.405%; 128 pulses: initialisation read spread 18.418%
8-pulse initialisation: max spread over full curve 48.092%; 32-pulse initialisation: max spread over full curve 82.790%; 128-pulse initialisation: max spread over full curve 34.013%
3 states, 1/10/100 τ retention and 1/16/80 reads; retention pass 5/9, read disturb pass 9/9.
Zero-line-resistance array assembled from native device trajectories; 81 initial-state combinations, max column readout relative error 25.650%. Real 1T1R not modelled.
